Ronway:

I would rather them create a die that has every match possibility on it, that way I can roll it and have everything determined with just a single roll.

RIght.

Let H = Number of hero possibilities (including variants, of course!)

Let E = Number of environments

Let V = Number of villains (standard playstyle)

Let W = Number of villains (Vengeance playstyle)

With that in mind, the number of possibilities (including 3, 4 and 5 hero teams) would be…

E * (( (3H-3) * (V + 3W-3)) + ( (4H-6) * (V + 4W-6))  + ( (5H-10) * (V + 5W-10)))

If someone wants to give me numbers, I'll plug them in and we'll see how many sides that die has… Or someone else can go for it, of course!
